# FLX-3609: a consumer query's tolerance or heldOut is malformed

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

tolerance is an exact decimal from 0 to 1 written as a string, never a float, and heldOut is a boolean (false when absent). The same reading applies to calibration.heldOutTolerance.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3609
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
